layout.body:
**Larissa Velez (10:00 A.M.)** Hey team, just a reminder that the marketing materials for our client’s newproduct launch need to be finalized by tomorrow.
**Miko Tanaka (10:05 A.M.)** Got it. I’ll finish the brochure design today.
**Pedro Alvarez (10:10 A.M.)** I’m working on the social media posts. They’ll be ready by the end of the day. I think we should generate some real excitement for Grenstar’s new smart-tracking water bottle.
**Sophia Nguyen (10:15 A.M.)** I’ll review the content when Miko and Pedro have finished and make any adjustments.
**Larissa Velez (10:20 A.M.)** Perfect. Make sure to double-check the dates and contact information. We know what happened last time.
**Sophia Nguyen (10:21 A.M.) Oh, yes, the client was not pleased. I am glad we started this doublechecking process. I will be sure to check the dates extra carefully.
**Larissa Velez (10:22 A.M.) Great, team! Here’s to a smoother launch of the water bottle than of the smart sportswear line!

questions.stem: At 10:20 A.M., what does Ms. Velez imply when she writes, "We know what happened last time"?

options.A: A client was especially pleased with a marketing campaign.
options.B: Some errors were made regarding a previous product launch.
options.C: A brochure was never sent out.
options.D: A marketing team did not complete a project in time.

questions.analysis: At 10:20 A.M., what does Ms. Velez imply when she writes, "We know what happened last time"? 原文依据：We know what happened last time. / Oh, yes, the client was not pleased. 我们知道上次发生了什么。/ 是的，客户当时很不满意。 A：客户对营销活动特别满意 → 错误 B：之前的产品发布出现了一些错误 → 正确 C：宣传册从未寄出 → 错误 D：营销团队未按时完成项目 → 错误
What product is being launched? 原文依据：generate some real excitement for Grenstar’s new smart-tracking water bottle 为格林斯塔新款智能追踪水杯造势 A：一款水杯 → 正确 B：一系列运动服装 → 错误 C：一款智能手机 → 错误 D：一款软件 → 错误

options.A: He will double-check the content of a brochure.
options.B: He is the main point of contact for a client.
options.C: He helped design a new product.
options.D: He will complete some postings by the end of the day.

questions.analysis: What does Mr. Alvarez indicate? 原文依据：I’m working on the social media posts. They’ll be ready by the end of the day. 我在做社交媒体帖子，今天下班前会完成。 A：他会仔细检查宣传册内容 → 错误 B：他是客户的主要联系人 → 错误 C：他帮忙设计了新产品 → 错误 D：他会在今天内完成一些帖子 → 正确
